headline: The Mall Group Allocates 600 Million Baht for Festive Season Retail Push
summary: Thailand's retail conglomerate The Mall Group allocated 600 million baht for year-end promotional campaigns, seeking a 20% increase in tourist traffic across its shopping complexes.
why: The Mall Group is a leading Thai department store and shopping mall operator; retail foot traffic mirrors domestic consumer demand.

impacts.name: Thai Retail Sector
impacts.why: Targeted marketing capital expenditures aim to capture elevated year-end tourism spending.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
